text:
Iris: Quick thread 1: need a minimal acceptance checklist for Console observability GA. Short bullets please.

Ben: must-haves: dashboards with non-empty data, basic tracing for four core flows, cost breakdown by model, and at least one alert wired.

Kemi: define non-empty: panels show data for last 24h and dashboard load <2s.

Omar: tracing: span at ingress and egress, tags: customer_id, route, model_version. sample slow >500ms + errors.

Riley: cost: token-level breakdown aggregated by model_version and team_id. projected hosted cost per 1M tokens < $28.

Ben: alerts: P95 latency, error-rate, and token-cost spikes. owners listed in runbook.

Iris: rollout plan: 5% canary for 48h, run automated gate every 2h. fail -> rollback.

Kemi: UX: add health badge for admins (green/yellow/red) and quick link to failing panels.

Omar: Private deployments require KMS markers in traces and exportable audit logs. make mandatory for Private GA.

status-bot: scheduled: observability-health-check created. runs every 02:00 UTC and on-demand.

Iris: owners: dashboards = Kemi, traces = Omar, cost = Riley, gates = Ben. I'll draft the checklist doc and post it to Confluence.

Riley: noted. will start schema change for labels this week.

Iris: thanks all, if no objections I'll lock this as the launch gate by EOD. :thumbsup:

Ben: :+1:

Kemi: :eyes:

Omar: 👍
